name: Material Location
description: A plant or store whose gate records material movements. Deliberately separate from Depot: a depot services buses and carries service engineers and a duty geofence, a plant builds them, and merging the two would put 'Hubli - Bus Manufacturing Plant' into every depot picker in the roster and job-card flows.

fields.label: Plant Type
fields.options:
Bus Manufacturing
Battery Manufacturing
Assembly
Warehouse
Service Depot
Other

fields.label: Gates
fields.description: One gate name per line. Offered as a dropdown at the gate; free text stays allowed because a new gate opens faster than a master is edited.

fields.label: Geofence Radius (m)
fields.description: Advisory only. A movement captured outside it is flagged for the supervisor, never refused - a gate is often a hundred metres from where the phone gets a fix.

fields.label: Linked Depot
fields.description: Optional. Set when this plant is co-located with a service depot.
